authority: STD-TPL-001 v0.14 §13.9 (proposed). One row per official-form table the Tenderer fills in. `treatment`: itemised (one field per column or cell), row-group (CTL-ROW-GROUP, release 1.4), interim (collapsed into text until `until_release`, when it becomes a failure), excluded or deferred (each needs a reason and the owner's decision date), open (a question awaiting the owner; reported, never silent). Source locators are lines of 01_source/ppra_goods_std_official.txt.

tables.source: SRC:2723 (b) Sole Proprietor: name in full, age, nationality, country of origin, citizenship
SRC:2735 (c) Partnership: names of partners, nationality, citizenship, % shares owned
SRC:2755 (d)(iii) Directors: names, nationality, citizenship, % shares owned
SRC:2750 (d)(i)-(ii) company type; nominal and issued capital in Kenya Shillings
SRC:2768 (e)(i) persons with an interest: names, designation in the Procuring Entity, interest or relationship
SRC:2777-2811 (e)(ii) nine conflict types, Yes/No, details if Yes
SRC:2214-2218 (l) each recipient's name, address, reason, amount and currency
SRC:2670-2683 items 7 and 8: the constitution and registration documents, organisational chart, Board list
tables.reason: The documents of items 7 and 8 stay one evidence requirement of 1 to 10 files, as in release 1.1 (open issue 89, owner decision "2.3 Keep one"). The upload names every required document. They are attachments, not a data table.
